next.reason: 1985 GR5: 'The END-PERFORM phrase delimits the scope of the in-line PERFORM statement.' 2023 states it through the general scope rules rather than a PERFORM rule: §2023:14.9.28.2 Format 2 (inline) ends with the required END-PERFORM, Table 12 gives END-PERFORM as PERFORM's scope terminator, and §2023:14.5.3.2 says 'The scope of a statement may be explicitly terminated by using its associated scope terminator as specified in Table 12'; GR1 and GR2 there make it terminate 'the most-recently preceding unterminated statement having the statement-name' and the unterminated statements between. Same delimiting for every 1985 in-line PERFORM. (The OPEN adjudicate answer missed the general rules: error mode b.)
